integer_method: BF16 and FP32 decode to signed integer coefficient times a power of two. Strip coefficient powers of two to canonical odd integers. Divide output dyadic by donor dyadic; look up exact finite BF16 X. Verify every product as integer equality with exponent normalization. No floating-point multiplication, division, rounding or tolerance is used in model recovery or validation.

cases: signed zero and normal/subnormal integer decoding

X_storage.reader: Direct ZIP_STORED local-header offset plus NumPy read-only uint16 memmap; no Torch or pickle import.

limits: Matches constrain only the128 even X features exported by this diagnostic; odd features are not observed and row indices remain ambiguous.
